articles.title: Holafly Discount Code: Which Official Code Fits Your Plan?
articles.description: Holafly's official discount page lists a code for short trips and another for monthly plans. See which one fits your order and where to enter it.
articles.how_to_heading: How to apply a Holafly discount code
articles.answer: Holafly's official discount page lists MYESIMNOW5 for 5% off a short-trip eSIM and MONTHLYPLAN10 for 10% off a monthly plan. Use the code that matches the product you select; Holafly says only one promo code can be applied per purchase.
steps: Choose either a destination and days for a short trip, or a monthly plan subscription.
At checkout, enter the matching code in Holafly's Discount code field and apply it.
Before payment, check that the changed total matches the code and product you selected.

details.heading: Short trips: MYESIMNOW5
details.body: Holafly labels MYESIMNOW5 as 5% off for short trips and says it is valid for any destination available in the Holafly Shop.

details.heading: Monthly plans: MONTHLYPLAN10
details.body: Holafly labels MONTHLYPLAN10 as 10% off for monthly plan subscriptions. Its official FAQ says this code applies to a monthly plan in the Plans section.

details.heading: Can the two codes be combined?
details.body: No. Holafly's official FAQ says only one promo code can be applied per purchase. Pick the code that corresponds to the plan you are buying rather than trying to stack both.

details.heading: Install before travel; activate after arrival
details.body: Holafly's iPhone installation guide says to install the eSIM shortly before a trip and wait until you arrive at the destination to activate it. This setup timing is separate from entering a discount code at checkout.

details.heading: If a code-looking error appears during eSIM setup
details.body: Holafly's setup support uses the message Code no longer valid for an eSIM-installation issue. Its guidance says the eSIM may already be installed or the connection may have dropped. That message is not, by itself, a statement that a checkout discount code failed.

articles.title: The Parking Spot Promo Code: Official Code, Deals & How to Apply
articles.description: Official The Parking Spot promo code, code-free deal guidance, and app steps checked on September 24, 2026.
target_keywords: discount code for the parking spot
articles.how_to_heading: How to use a The Parking Spot promo code
articles.answer: The Parking Spot’s official coupons page currently lists FALL10 for eligible Fall airport-parking reservations with entry by November 15, 2026. Before confirming a reservation, check My Discounts: its official support page says discounts cannot be combined and the highest eligible discount is applied.

codes.title: Fall airport-parking promotion
codes.body: The official coupons page lists this code for 10% or more off eligible Fall airport-parking reservations with entry by November 15, 2026.

deals.title: Book early for the best available rate
deals.body: The official support page says pricing can change daily with availability and recommends booking early; reservations are required to access discounted rates.

deals.title: Check My Discounts before selecting a parking type
deals.body: The official support page says My Discounts shows the offers considered for a reservation and the highest eligible discount is applied.

steps: In the app, open Reserve Your Spot. The official support page says app promo codes require a Spot Club membership.
Select the airport and your check-in date and time, then enter the promo code on that screen.
Continue to choose the facility and parking type.
Open My Discounts to see which offers are being considered before completing the reservation.

details.heading: Check whether another discount is already better
details.body: The official support page says discounts cannot be combined. If a better eligible discount is already applied, a promo code will not be accepted.

details.heading: Confirm the reservation type and location
details.body: The official support page says discounts do not apply to Basic parking reservations or partner locations. Recheck the selected facility and parking type before booking.

articles.title: Airalo Discount Code: Official Promo Code and Checkout Guide
articles.description: Airalo's official current discount code, referral offer, and checkout steps, checked on September 26, 2026.
articles.how_to_heading: How to use an Airalo discount code
articles.answer: Yes. Airalo’s official discounts page currently lists SEPTEMBER15 for 15% off a first eSIM. Log in, choose an eSIM, then enter the code at checkout. Airalo also says a discount code, referral code, and Airmoney cannot be combined in one order.

facts.condition: Airalo lists this as a first-eSIM offer. Log in and redeem the code during checkout.
Airalo says a successful referral gives USD $3 Airmoney to the referrer and USD $3 to the referred person.
Use either a discount or referral code, or Airmoney. Airalo says they cannot be combined in the same order.

steps: Log in to your Airalo account on the website or in the app.
Choose the eSIM you want and select Buy Now.
At checkout, select Use Airmoney or code. On the website, select Code and enter the discount code before choosing Redeem.
Use only one discount method for the order. If a code does not apply, check whether Airmoney or a referral code is already selected.

faqs.question: Where do I enter an Airalo promo code?
faqs.answer: On the Airalo website, go to checkout, choose Use Airmoney or code, select Code, enter the code, and choose Redeem. In the app, use the same checkout area and tap Apply after entering the code.

faqs.question: Can I combine an Airalo promo code with a referral code or Airmoney?
faqs.answer: No. Airalo says only one discount method can be used for each purchase: a discount or referral code, or Airmoney.

faqs.question: Who can use Airalo promo codes?
faqs.answer: Airalo says most discount and promo codes are for new users who have not made an eSIM purchase, while some can apply to all users and purchases. Check the official discounts page for the current offer terms.

articles.title: Nomad eSIM Promo Code: Official Referral and Checkout Guide
articles.description: Official Nomad eSIM referral and promo-code guidance, eligibility rules, and checkout steps checked on September 26, 2026.
articles.how_to_heading: How to use a Nomad eSIM referral or promo code
articles.answer: The Nomad eSIM official pages checked for this guide do not publish a universal promo code. Instead, a new customer can use a friend’s valid referral code at checkout for a first-purchase discount. Enter it in the Add Promo Code field, or save it first under My Account > Promos.

facts.condition: Nomad says a new user with no previous purchase history can use one valid friend referral code for a first-purchase discount.
Referral codes cannot be used after a previous purchase or trial eSIM, and cannot be used on unlimited plans, plans already on sale, or plans priced below USD $5.
Nomad directs users to Profile > Promo for available offers and terms. Official promo codes can have plan and prior-use restrictions.

steps: Log in to the Nomad eSIM website or app and choose an eligible eSIM plan.
At checkout, enter a valid friend referral code in the Add Promo Code field.
Alternatively, open My Account > Promos and save the referral code to your profile before checkout.
If the code does not apply, check that the account has no previous purchase or trial eSIM and that the selected plan is not unlimited, already on sale, or priced below USD $5.

faqs.question: Does Nomad eSIM publish a universal promo code?
faqs.answer: The official Nomad eSIM pages checked for this guide describe referral codes, account-specific promotions, and seasonal offers, but do not publish a universal code for all visitors.

faqs.question: Where do I enter a Nomad eSIM referral code?
faqs.answer: At checkout, enter the code in the Add Promo Code field. Nomad also says you can save it first under My Account > Promos.

faqs.question: Why is my Nomad eSIM promo or referral code not working?
faqs.answer: Check that the account is eligible and that the selected plan is eligible. Nomad says codes cannot be used after a prior purchase or trial eSIM, or on unlimited plans, plans already on sale, or plans priced below USD $5.

articles.title: WallyPark Promo Code: Official Airport Parking Discounts
articles.description: Current WallyPark promo codes, eligibility rules, and reservation steps from official WallyPark pages, checked on September 26, 2026.
articles.how_to_heading: How to use a WallyPark promo code
articles.answer: Yes. WallyPark’s official site currently lists CRISP26 for up to 40% off eligible airport-parking reservations. Enter it while making an online reservation; the official terms say it is for stays of two days or longer with check-in on or before November 19, 2026, and it cannot be combined with other discounts.

facts.offer: CRISP26 — up to 40% off eligible reservations
facts.condition: Use on an online reservation for a stay of two days or longer with check-in on or before November 19, 2026. WallyPark says it cannot be combined with other discounts, prior reservations, or drive-up stays.
Enter the code during reservation and show an AAA card at checkout. WallyPark says it cannot be used for drive-up stays or with other promotional or corporate discounts.

facts.offer: SENIOR15, MIL25, and GOV25 — eligibility-based discounts
facts.condition: Use the matching code during reservation and show the required identification at checkout. WallyPark lists age, military, or government-employee eligibility and location exclusions in its FAQ.

steps: Choose your airport, parking type, and reservation dates on WallyPark.com or in the WallyPark app.
Before continuing, select Apply Promo and enter an eligible code.
Review the updated promo rate and the offer terms before confirming the reservation.
Bring any required membership or eligibility identification to checkout when using AAA, senior, military, or government discounts.

faqs.question: Where do I enter a WallyPark promo code?
faqs.answer: After selecting a parking type, choose Apply Promo instead of continuing, then enter the code. WallyPark says eligible current email offers may also appear for customers who opted in to marketing emails.

faqs.question: Can I combine WallyPark promo codes?
faqs.answer: No. WallyPark’s terms say promotional codes cannot be combined with other offers or discounts. Its FAQ also says only one promotional code can be redeemed online when making a reservation.

faqs.question: Why is my WallyPark promo code not working?
faqs.answer: Check the code’s reservation dates, stay length, location restrictions, and eligibility. WallyPark says promo codes cannot be used for drive-up stays, and eligibility-based discounts require supporting identification at checkout.
